title: Dan Campbell: Detroit Lions RB Jahmyr Gibbs has only scratched the surface, can play some receiver

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Dan Campbell: Detroit Lions RB Jahmyr Gibbs has only scratched the surface, can play some receiver
sources.description: Lions running back Jahmyr Gibbs is the betting favorite to be the NFL's Offensive Player of the Year, and from Lions coach Dan Campbell's comments, that sounds like a safe bet.
